core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; OTC Medications; Personal Care; Baby Care; Medical Devices; Convenience Items
specialty_focus: Farmacia Simán is a leading pharmacy chain in Honduras operating over 277 brick-and-mortar stores plus e-commerce and mobile app platforms. It follows a 'Complete Pharmacy' model, offering a one-stop destination for pharmaceutical and daily health needs, with omnichannel accessibility including digital integration, call center support, and home delivery. While it carries medical devices as part of its product mix, its primary focus is retail pharmacy distribution rather than wearable medical devices specifically.
key_brands: CGM Vivachek, Broncopulmín, Espasmo-Tropín, Fungifar, ACFOL DHA, others
